title: VillagerBreedControl
description: A plugin to control the number of baby villagers spawned per breeding event.
body:
**VillagerBreedControl is a lightweight Paper/Spigot plugin that allows server owners to control how many baby villagers spawn during breeding.**

By default, Minecraft spawns only one baby villager per breeding event. This plugin lets you configure a custom amount, making it easier to manage villager farms or create unique gameplay mechanics.

# Features

• Set custom baby count per breeding event

• Configurable limits to prevent lag

• Compatible with Paper and Spigot

• Lightweight and optimized

# Configuration
You can configure:

• Babies per breeding event

• Random breeding range

• Cooldowns to prevent farm abuse
